integrity_notes: All proof statements are analytically derived; finite rational checks are supplementary. The sample-maximum CDF and previously named related distributions are not claimed novel.
scientific_limitations: Only nonnegative, iid zero-based geometric samples and positive integer sample sizes; ordinary additive, not max-based, divisibility. A historical exponentiated-geometric article was only partially accessible; independent novelty audit unperformed.
title: A sharp two-draw infinite-divisibility cutoff for geometric sample maxima
